lines.tts: In 1938, an entire English town hunted a man who never existed.

lines.tts: This is Halifax. Dark streets, thick fog, and very nervous people.
lines.text: This is Halifax. Dark streets, thick fog, and very nervous people.

lines.tts: One November night, two women say a man jumped them with a mallet.
lines.text: One November night, two women say a man jumped them with a mallet.

lines.tts: They didn't see his face. But they did notice his shiny shoe buckles.

lines.tts: Days later, another woman says he cut her. Then another. Then a man.

lines.tts: Now the town has a name for him. The Halifax Slasher.

lines.tts: Shops close early. Nobody walks alone. And the men form patrols.

lines.tts: Armed with sticks, they beat the shit out of anyone who looks slightly slashy.

lines.tts: One guy runs to help a victim, and the mob decides he's the slasher and chants for his head.

lines.tts: Scotland Yard sends detectives up from London.

lines.tts: You see, a rumor is like a streetlamp in fog. It doesn't show you more. It just makes every shadow look bigger.

lines.tts: Then one victim, Percy, admits he cut himself. Then another admits it. And another.

lines.tts: There was no slasher. No mallet. No buckles.

lines.tts: Five locals were charged with public mischief, and four went to prison.

lines.tts: The only people the Halifax Slasher ever hurt were the people hunting him.
